summary: c1 is an introduced coverage obligation: the before parser exposed only a legacy-width salt, while the after parser supports a caller-supplied 16-byte salt. The fixed harness still calls only the legacy setter.

claims.necessity_reason: The retained target-coverage obligation is supported after the change and has no equivalent route in the fixed harness.

before.requirement: Configure a parser with a caller-supplied 16-byte salt before parsing, then use and inherit that full-width key.
before.reason: The before parser stores an unsigned-long salt and copies it into a SipHash key with the high half fixed to zero. Its setter accepts only unsigned long; the verified preimage has no XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes definition.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The verified preimage file has no definition of the new setter.
The before setter takes an unsigned-long salt.

after.requirement: Configure a parser with a caller-supplied 16-byte salt before parsing, then use and inherit that full-width key.
after.reason: The added setter installs all 16 supplied bytes before parsing, and hashing and child creation use the full-width state. The old harness never calls that setter; its legacy setter writes zero to the high half.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Hashing copies the full-width parser salt.
Child parsers inherit the full-width salt state.
The harness's legacy setter fixes the high half to zero.

claims.comparison_reason: The same caller-supplied full-width-key tuple was unavailable under the before source and is supported but unreachable through the fixed harness under the after source.
